newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sidek shareholders say no news at meeting.
newsitem.headline: Sidek shareholders say no news at meeting.

text.p: Shareholders at Grupo Sidek's stockholder assembly on Tuesday said they were disappointed that the company proposed no solutions to the company's mountainous debt burden nor an explanation of accounting irregularities.

"The two hours were a waste of time. The company is keeping a tight lid on everything and only told us again that they are investigating the irregularities," a shareholder and representative of a Mexican bank who declined to be named told Reuters.
Shareholders at the meeting criticized the company for not clearing up its financial situation and management plans.

"They didn't assign responsibility and didn't say what they would do," said a national brokerage director who declined to be named. "The company should have another assembly to decide what to do about these irregularities."

The New York Stock Exchange and Mexican stock market (Bolsa) suspended the company's shares briefly in early March after the company said it uncovered management irregularities and posted negative majority stockholders' equity.
The company's tourism division Situr saw one of the sharpest drops on the stock market on Tuesday, falling one centavo to 0.24 pesos.
